title: Receiving on a no-charge work order shows its own cost-only notice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Goodwill, in status Approved, with one special-order part, part 1, ordered and not yet received.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the receive screen for part 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The notice reads "No Charge work order: cost only, no sell price".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R19: “No event writes a sell price onto an internal or no-charge work order, or onto a no-charge line (Story 12): not receiving a special-order part at a real cost, not editing the cost on a vendor invoice, not a core-charge change (today each of these derives or rewrites the part's sell price from the cost). Cost is written normally. The receive screen replaces its notice "Updating the cost also updates the sell price" with "Internal work order: cost only, no sell price" (or "No Charge work order: cost only, no sell price", "No Charge line: cost only"); the vendor-invoice item edit, which has no such notice today, gains the same cost-only notice for items on internal and no-charge work orders and lines. A sell price appears only on Convert to Billable or Mark as Billable, derived from the cost on the line at that moment (S2-R6, S12-R5).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
